venue.details: Selected venue: Shangri-La Paris (10 Avenue d'Iéna, Paris 16e). ADVERTISED CAPACITY: The venue markets up to 500 guests for combined historic salons and 100 on-site rooms (frenchweddingstyle.com/wedding-venues/shangri-la-paris). For a 100-guest wedding specifically: the Grand Salon accommodates ~100–120 seated (magicdayevents.com/shangri-la-paris-wedding) and La Salle à Manger seats 56–100 (weddingvenuesdirectory.com/listing/shangri-la-paris), so the advertised capacity fits the requested guest count of 100. Jazz/dancing: the Grand Salon ballroom is the standard dinner+dancing space; a live jazz band is bookable via the hotel/planner (not confirmed in sources). CONFIRMED DATE AVAILABILITY: None — no source confirms availability for 2027-03-14; advertised capacity is NOT the same as a confirmed booking, which requires contacting events.slpr@shangri-la.com. NEARBY AIRPORT: Charles de Gaulle (CDG), cited by French Wedding Style as the nearest airport at ~24.7 km; Paris Orly (ORY) is also viable. Rejected venues list was empty and no prior flight/venue error, so no exclusions applied. Sources: https://www.frenchweddingstyle.com/wedding-venues/shangri-la-paris ; https://magicdayevents.com/shangri-la-paris-wedding ; https://weddingvenuesdirectory.com/listing/shangri-la-paris
